teachingSource.title: Expressing Ability — can / can't
teachingSource.rule: *can* (-ebilmek) yapabildiklerimizi, *can't* yapamadıklarımızı anlatır. Soruda *can* özneden önce gelir.

examples.en: *Can* a cheetah run fast? — Yes, it can.
examples.tr: Bir çita hızlı koşabilir mi? — Evet.

examples.en: *Can* a penguin fly? — No, it can't.

teachingSource.title: Comparative Adjectives
teachingSource.rule: Tek heceli + *-er* · "e" ile biten + *-r* · sessiz-sesli-sessiz → son harf çiftlenir + *-er* · sessiz+y → *-ier* · iki+ heceli → *more* + sıfat

examples.en: fast → fast*er*  ·  large → large*r*  ·  big → big*ger*
An elephant is *bigger than* a lion.
examples.tr: Bir fil bir aslandan daha büyüktür.

teachingSource.title: Superlative Adjectives
teachingSource.rule: Üstünlük hâllerinden önce *the* kullanılır. Tek heceli + *-est* · "e" ile biten + *-st* · sessiz-sesli-sessiz → çiftle + *-est* · sessiz+y → *-iest* · iki+ heceli → *most* + sıfat

examples.en: fast → the fast*est*  ·  large → the large*st*  ·  big → the big*gest*
heavy → the heav*iest*  ·  dangerous → the *most* dangerous
Lions are *the strongest* animals in the forests.
Whales are *the largest* animals in the oceans.
Parrots are *the most colourful* wild birds.
The giraffe is *the tallest* animal here.
heavy → the heav*iest*  ·  dangerous → the *most* dangerous
Lions are *the strongest* animals in the forests.

The giraffe is *the tallest* animal here.
Parrots are *the most colourful* wild birds.
